name: Daring Acrobatics
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Prize Wheel: Drag wheel → spinning shield blocks knives.
Iron Mask: Drag mask → smashes incoming blade.
Jason Mask: Place mask on board → protects target.
Kung Fu Block: Tap legs → catch knife with reflex move.
Ceiling Fan Hook: Tap hooks → lift man off board.
Funhouse Mirror: Drag mirror → clown hits own reflection.
Springboard: Place spring → launch man away from danger.
Dummy Head: Place head → absorbs knife hit.
Halloween Pumpkin: Drag pumpkin → covers head for protection.
Wig Shield: Place wig → blocks final projectile.
